overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sets an HTTP client option (e.g. timeout, redirect handling, compression, auth dialog, logging) to be used by the next request issued via HTTP Get or HTTP Request.

constraints: Options are local to the current process (or, inside a component, to the executing component).
If the same option is set more than once before the next request, only the value from the last call is used.

Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): HTTP client protocol: HTTP AUTHENTICATE / HTTP SET OPTION / HTTP SET CERTIFICATES FOLDER configure per-process client state -> HTTP Get or HTTP Request issues the request and consumes that state -> HTTP GET OPTION / HTTP Get certificates folder read back the currently active state.
